checks: Cost components switch from bar to categorical line with exact values and an explicit non-trend caption
Cost pie uses the same three additive components, leaves the response immutable and makes no analytical request
Narration fact highlighting survives chart-type changes and clears correctly
Chart choice survives rerender of identical evidence; a stale chart identifier cannot change another visible chart
Disjoint headcount and cost segments support pie within their original scope and period
Rates, repeated periods, suppression, signed economics and overlapping scenario measures refuse misleading pies without changing the chart
Zero-total pies are refused and scope/source revisions produce distinct chart identities
Phone line and pie layouts retain all exact values without horizontal page overflow
A hidden Studio chart cannot be changed through the renderer API
No browser errors, provider calls or workforce-data mutations

refused.name: rate
refused.reason: Rates have separate denominators; they are not slices of one total.

refused.name: time
refused.reason: These are repeated periods, not parts of one total. Use bar or line.

refused.name: suppressed
refused.reason: Pie is unavailable while any value is suppressed or missing.

refused.name: retention
refused.reason: Pie cannot represent negative values. Bar and line preserve their signs.

refused.name: skills
refused.reason: These measures are not verified parts of a single total. Use bar or line to keep their meaning.
